title: Let Him Cook
blurb: A plea not to interrupt somebody mid-brilliance, delivered with genuine faith and no evidence whatsoever. What makes the phrase so useful is that it is entirely agnostic about the outcome — whether the person is actually cooking or heading directly into disaster is beside the point, because the whole appeal lies in finding out. It became the default comment on everything from clutch gameplay to unhinged threads written at two in the morning. Sometimes he was not, in the end, cooking. We let him anyway, and we would again.
origin: The viral 'let him cook' hype phrase from streaming and sports culture.
